name: CDPServer::acceptLoop
target_component: DevTools frontend (CDP client, e.g. Chrome DevTools/puppeteer)
data: Creates AF_INET SOCK_STREAM TCP listen socket, setsockopt(SO_REUSEADDR), bind()/listen() on configured port, then accept() loop; each accepted fd becomes a CDPConnection pumped until close; on client disconnect notifies dispatcher->onConnectionClosed(). Log: 'cdp: devtools server listening on port %d'.

name: CDPConnection::CDPConnection
data: Per-connection handler over the accepted TCP fd; serves HTTP discovery endpoints (/json/version, /json, /json/list returning Browser/Protocol-Version and webSocketDebuggerUrl ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/) and performs RFC6455 WebSocket handshake (GUID 258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11) to carry CDP JSON; writes via send(fd, ..., MSG_NOSIGNAL), closes fd in destructor.

name: CDPCommand::emit
data: Serializes a rapidjson CDP response/event document (adding sessionId when present) and sends the UTF-8 JSON text via CDPServer::sendText -> CDPConnection over the DevTools socket. Used by sendResult()/sendResultEmpty()/sendEvent().

name: CDPDispatcher::route
data: Routes each incoming CDP command (domain.method with CDPCommand payload) to per-domain processMessage handlers: Target, Page, Runtime, DOM, DOMDebugger, Log, Network, Fetch, Input, Emulation, CSS, DOMSnapshot, DOMStorage, Storage, Accessibility, Performance, Memory, Animation, Tracing, Overlay, plus inline IO.read/IO.close stream support for Page.printToPDF ReturnAsStream (drained by puppeteer).

name: CDPDispatcher::onConnectionClosed
data: Invoked when the DevTools client's socket connection closes; resets connection-scoped CDP session state on the main thread so the next client gets a fresh attach handshake (otherwise browser.pages() is empty on reconnect).

name: CDPDispatcher::emitConsoleForWebView
data: Builds a Runtime.consoleAPICalled event (level, args array of {type,value}, executionContextId) for the session owning the WebView and sends it over the CDP connection via CDPCommand::sendEvent.

name: CDPDispatcher::emitBindingCalled
data: Routes to the TargetContext/session owning the originating WebView and, when runtimeEnabled, emits Runtime.bindingCalled with params {name, payload, executionContextId}.

name: bindingNativeCallback (RuntimeDomain)
data: Native callback installed by Runtime.addBinding: resolves the originating WebView from the executing global object, extracts the string payload argument, and forwards it via cdpServer()->dispatcher()->emitBindingCalled (Runtime.bindingCalled). Returns undefined to page JS; puppeteer's helper tracks the result via a separate callback.

name: RuntimeDomain::injectBinding
data: Defines a native window[name] function (with BindingExtra name) in the page's script context; calls to it are relayed back to the DevTools client as Runtime.bindingCalled events. Re-injected on navigation by PageDomain::finishNavigation.

name: RuntimeDomain::processMessage
data: Handles incoming CDP Runtime.* commands: processMessage(CDPCommand& cmd, const std::string& method); replies over the DevTools connection via CDPCommand.

name: RuntimeDomain::callFunctionOn
data: CDP Runtime callFunctionOn handler: callFunctionOn(WebView* wv, BrowsingContext* bc, CDPCommand& cmd) executes a function on a remote object in the page context and returns the result over the DevTools connection.

name: RuntimeDomain::compileScript
data: CDP Runtime compileScript handler: compileScript(WebView* wv, BrowsingContext* bc, CDPCommand& cmd) compiles script source in the page context and replies via CDPCommand.

name: RuntimeDomain::getProperties
data: CDP Runtime getProperties handler: getProperties(WebView* wv, BrowsingContext* bc, CDPCommand& cmd) inspects a remote object's properties and replies via CDPCommand.

name: RuntimeDomain::globalLexicalScopeNames
data: CDP Runtime globalLexicalScopeNames handler: globalLexicalScopeNames(WebView* wv, CDPCommand& cmd) returns global lexical scope names via CDPCommand.

name: RuntimeDomain::evaluateSource
data: CDP Runtime evaluate implementation: evaluateSource(WebView* wv, BrowsingContext* bc, const std::string& exprStr, bool returnByValue, bool awaitPromise, CDPCommand& cmd) evaluates an expression string in the browsing context and replies over the DevTools connection.

name: DOMDomain::processMessage
data: Handles incoming CDP DOM.* commands: processMessage(CDPCommand& cmd, const std::string& method).

name: DOMDebuggerDomain::processMessage
data: Handles incoming CDP DOMDebugger.* commands: processMessage(CDPCommand& cmd, const std::string& method).

name: TracingDomain::processMessage
data: Handles incoming CDP Tracing.* commands: processMessage(CDPCommand& cmd, const std::string& method).

name: PageDomain::finishNavigation
data: On navigation completion for a CDP session: evaluates Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument scripts before page script runs, re-injects Runtime.addBinding bindings into the new document's main world, resets node/remote-object handle registries and child frames, and (when pageEnabled) builds and emits a frame lifecycle event with the frame object to the client.

name: initDebuggerIfNeeds
target_component: Remote script debugger client (Escargot debugger protocol)
data: When STARFISH_ENABLE_DEBUGGER is defined: for window contexts with scripting enabled, asks the WebView host via DebuggerShouldInit handler (url, port), then starts the Escargot script debugger server with startDebugger(port, 1000), listening on TCP port starting at 6501 for the top-level browsing context and incrementing per context.

name: Inspector::worker
data: Creates nn::socket(AF_SP, NN_PAIR), binds to the configured address, then recv(NN_MSG, NN_DONTWAIT) loop parsing JSON {"command", "content"}: 'ping' is answered with {"command":"pong"}; 'eval' evaluates JavaScript in the WebView (via commandEvaluator on the main loop) and returns the result as a console-info message.

message_ids.payload: JSON {"command":"eval","content":<JS source>}; result returned as console-info

name: Inspector::sendInfoMessage
data: Sends JSON {"command":"console-info","content":<message text>} over the nanomsg NN_PAIR socket (m_nnmSocket->send).

name: Inspector::sendErrorMessage
data: Sends JSON {"command":"console-error","content":<message text>} over the nanomsg NN_PAIR socket.

name: Inspector::sendWarnMessage
data: Sends JSON {"command":"console-warn","content":<message text>} over the nanomsg NN_PAIR socket.

name: Inspector::sendDebugMessage
data: Sends JSON {"command":"console-debug","content":<message text>} over the nanomsg NN_PAIR socket.

name: SSDPRunnable::initSocket
target_component: SSDP multicast group / cast sender devices on local network
data: Creates UDP socket (AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM|SOCK_NONBLOCK|SOCK_CLOEXEC) with SO_REUSEADDR, binds to SSDP_GROUP:SSDP_PORT and joins the IP multicast group (IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP with the local interface address) to receive SSDP M-SEARCH discovery requests and answer with M-SEARCH responses pointing at the DIAL location URL.

name: SSDPRunnable::preRun
target_component: SSDP multicast group on local network
data: Thread pre-run hook: initializes the SSDP UDP multicast socket via initSocket() before the recvfrom/sendto discovery loop (M-SEARCH requests answered with templateMSearchResponse containing local address and LOCATION_PORT).

name: DIALRunnable::doRun
target_component: DIAL client devices on local network (cast senders)
data: Runs an httplib HTTP server listening on the local address at LOCATION_PORT: GET LOCATION_DESC returns the DIAL device description XML with Application-URL header (http://<local>:<port><CAST_APP_URL>); registers CastApplication 'YouTube' (http://www.youtube.com/tv?) DIAL application endpoints; debug builds log all GET/POST paths.

name: ExecutionContext::addActiveWebSockets
target_component: Remote WebSocket server (Not identifiable from code)
data: Registers an active WebSocket client connection with the execution context (guarded by STARFISH_ENABLE_WEBSOCKET); the context tracks all open WebSocket connections for lifecycle management.

name: ExecutionContext::disposeActiveWebSockets
target_component: Remote WebSocket server (Not identifiable from code)
data: On context teardown, disposes (closes) every remaining active WebSocket connection via webSocket->dispose().

name: MessageChannel::MessageChannel
source_component: JS context creating the channel (port1 holder)
target_component: JS context receiving the transferred port (port2 holder)
data: Creates two MessagePort objects (port1/port2) and entangles them via MessagePort::entangle, forming a two-way message channel whose ports are transferable to other contexts.

name: MessagePort::MessagePort
data: Message-port endpoint holding a PortMessageQueue and structured-clone serializer (Serializer::serializeWithTransfer). postMessage(message, transfer) serializes with transfer per the HTML spec and dispatches a MessageEvent on the entangled port; transfer()/transferReceive() ship the port (TransferedMessagePort) to another context, moving queued tasks and re-entangling.

name: MessagePort::setOnmessage
data: Registers the 'message' attribute event listener; per spec, the first assignment enables the port message queue as if start() had been called, so queued MessageEvents begin to be delivered.

name: Fetch::fetch
target_component: Remote HTTP server (URL from Request; Not identifiable from code)
data: fetch(ExecutionContext*, RequestInfo&) and the RequestInit overload (line 133) create a Request and Promise, then Fetch::start() issues the network ResourceRequest. On success, fills Response with status, statusText, redirected, type, mimeType, url, response headers and body stream, fulfilling the promise; on failure rejects with TypeError 'Failed to fetch'.
